taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station BMGS-bori-field (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1005 | 3.42 | 3.42
2 | 3588 | 6.33 | 9.76
3 | 1358 | 10.9 | 20.7
4 | 333 | 9.08 | 29.7
5 | 2950 | 36.8 | 66.5
6 | 5469 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: BMGS-bori-field
Curve type: KQHA (combination curve: K from layers 1‑3, Q from layers 2‑4, H from layers 3‑5, A from layers 4‑6)
Aquifer depth: 20.7 m – 29.7 m (Layer 4, low‑resistivity zone of 333 Ω·m)
Recommendation: Target drilling to the 20.7–29.7 m interval where the pronounced resistivity low indicates a probable water‑bearing horizon; case and seal the overlying high‑resistivity layers (down to ~20.7 m) to prevent cross‑contamination and ensure a clean screen placement within the identified aquifer zone.
